name: Hagukumi Sacrifice Dai 0 Wa - Prologue
original_name: はぐくみ Sacrifice -サクリファイス- 第0話 Prologue
source:
Pre-story describing the trouble of the Church of the Saints with the occult matters. These events get referenced in Episode 1 as "Last week".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
